commands:
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1311/${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}
gh pr diff 1311 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1311/${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}/diff.patch | head -0
echo "=== FILES ==="
grep '^diff --git' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1311/${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}/diff.patch
echo "=== STATS ==="
wc -l .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1311/${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}/ …[per-command-truncated]

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; git ls-files --error-unmatch .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/pretooluse-shape-guard.py >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "TRACKED" || echo "not tracked"; echo "---diff base vs vendored (should be identical if mirror kept in sync)---"; diff <(git show HEAD:scripts/pretooluse-shape-guard.py) <(git show HEAD:.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/pretooluse-shape-guard.py) >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "IDENTICAL at HEAD/base" || echo "DIFFERENT at base"

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; git ls-files --error-unmatch .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/pretooluse-shape-guard.py >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "TRACKED" || echo "not tracked"; git show HEAD:scripts/pretooluse-shape-guard.py > /tmp/a.py; git show HEAD:.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/pretooluse-shape-guard.py > /tmp/b.py; diff -q /tmp/a.py /tmp/b.py && echo "IDENTICAL at base" || echo "DIFFERENT at base"

git status --porcelain --ignored .prflow/vendor/ 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo "---"; git check-ignore .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/pretooluse-shape-guard.py && echo "IGNORED (runtime artifact, out of scope)"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
